title: Laravel 10 CI job blocked by Composer security advisories
context: Composer 2.9.5 refuses every Laravel 10.x release (security advisories), so the L10 CI leg with block-insecure on is always red and release can never pass CI. With block-insecure off it passes 149/149.

options.label: Turn off block-insecure for the L10 test job, like L11 (test-only; apps still decide for themselves)
Remove the L10 job from CI; Laravel 10 stays supported but untested in CI
Drop Laravel 10 from composer.json support range (breaking for L10 users)

rationale: Developer chose to allow insecure Laravel 10 releases in the CI test job only, matching Laravel 11
